outcome: Maternal body weight and weight gain
Foetal skeleton abnormalities (incomplete ossification of skull, sternebrae, metatarsal bones)
cohort: The study included 50 pregnant female Sprague Dawley rats (dams) distributed into five groups.
finding: High doses of Verbena officinalis extracts significantly reduced maternal body weight gain and induced embryo-foetotoxicity, including decreased foetal weight, length, and skeletal abnormalities, indicating it is unsafe for use during pregnancy.
followup_time: Observation during gestation from day 6 to day 21.
birth_weight: Foetal weight was measured as an outcome.
gest_age: Late gestation (treatment from day 6 to day 20, assessment on day 21 of gestation).
